summary: MilestoneProgressClient.read() checks the wire shape of GET /milestone-progress and maps its snake_case fields (total_tasks, step_started_at, last_tool, last_text, pull_request, baseline_red) to camelCase, following EpicGroomClient's pattern; an unrecognised state, task status or attention kind, a refused response, or a network failure all collapse to {kind:'unavailable'}, never a thrown error. The five tests named in the brief pass, plus a mutation check on #isSliceLineState confirmed the boundary test actually catches a broken validation. The frontend's node_modules were missing in this worktree; `npm ci` had to run before any vitest/build command would work, so a fresh worktree needs that step too. `npx vitest run --maxWorkers=4` (76 files, 1649 passed, 1 skipped) and `npm run build` both pass with no regressions.

task_name: The hook reopens an ended session
summary: CoordinatingSessionClient.reopen(target) posts to /coordinating-session/reopen with the x-coordinating-target header and reuses the existing openedIn boundary model for a 202, or productError for a refusal; useCoordinatingSession().reopen() reads the held target from heldRef and runs the call through the existing runOpening state machine, answering the shared BLOCKED_OPENING refusal with no fetch when nothing is held. The brief's TDD line named all three new tests as living "in client.test.ts", but the third one (reopen with no held session sends nothing) is a hook-level guard the client function cannot express on its own, since the client always sends whatever target it is given; I put it in useCoordinatingSession.test.ts instead, which the brief's own Files line already listed as (modify), and left client.test.ts with the two tests that are genuinely about the wire call. Two mutations (a wrong POST path, and removing the hook's null-target guard) were introduced by hand and both were caught by these tests before being reverted. `npx vitest run src/app/coordinating-session --maxWorkers=4` (48 passed), `npx vitest run --maxWorkers=4` (76 files, 1652 passed, 1 skipped, no regressions) and `npm run build` all pass.
